strings.welcome.doc:
# Welcome to MakDown

Markdown, but **fancier**. Edit on the left, watch it render on the right.

## Try these
- [x] Switch themes in *Settings* (Ctrl+,): GitHub, Windows 11, TTY, opencode, Warm ...
- [ ] Turn on **vimkeys** (Ctrl+Alt+V) and press `Esc`, then `dd`, `yy`, `p`, `u`
- [ ] Toggle paragraph marks (Ctrl+Shift+L) for Word-style ¶ marks
- [ ] Toggle *reveal markers* (Ctrl+Shift+M) to see the hidden `*`, `-`, `#` in the preview

> Tip: clone a preset in Settings, give it a name and make it your own.

### A table
| Key            | Action            |
|----------------|:-----------------:|
| Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I| bold / italic     |
| Ctrl+K         | insert link       |
| Alt+Up/Down    | move line (vim)   |

### Code
```cpp
int main() { return 0; }   // fenced blocks get their own styling
```

strings.theme.frameHint: MakDown draws its own title bar and a themed window border instead of the Windows ones. Resizing, snapping and the shadow stay native. Turn off to get the standard Windows frame (takes effect when you close Settings).

strings.editor.vimHint: Modal editing (normal / insert / visual, d y c p u, counts, :w :q, /search) plus extras: Alt+Up/Down moves a line, Ctrl+Shift+D duplicates it, Ctrl+D / Ctrl+U scroll half a page.
strings.editor.marksHint: Word-style formatting marks: a pilcrow after every paragraph.
strings.editor.spacesHint: Dots for spaces, arrows for tabs.
strings.editor.sidebarHint: Files, Search and Git on the left (Ctrl+Shift+E).
strings.preview.revealHint: Shows the usually invisible *, -, #, > and ` characters as faint ghost glyphs in the preview.
strings.preview.liveHint: Re-render while typing. When off, press F5 or save to refresh.
strings.preview.syncHint: The preview follows the editor's scroll position.
strings.preview.liveReloadHint: Browser tabs reload when the page or its .html / .js / .css files change on disk.
strings.anim.0.name: Don't distract me
strings.anim.1.name: Keep it sober
strings.anim.1.hint: Quick fades and the explorer sliding in and out.
strings.anim.2.name: Make it pretty
strings.anim.2.hint: Fades, sliding panels, the window fading in and themes cross-fading when you switch.
strings.anim.3.name: Entertain me
strings.anim.3.hint: Everything above, slower and springier, smooth wheel scrolling, and a dancing equalizer in the audio preview.
